topics.title: Prediction vs inference
topics.description: Prediction estimates an unseen outcome, while inference asks what relationships the data support; the goal determines the method and evaluation.

lessons.title: Core idea and practice
lessons.body: Prediction estimates an unseen outcome, while inference asks what relationships the data support; the goal determines the method and evaluation. Separate a sales forecast from a causal claim about a promotion. This distinction should be checked against the data, users, and constraints of the actual task rather than treated as a guarantee.
